decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk line builds on the firm's office competence and fits the post-pandemic demand for flexible, representative workplaces, so its upside remains open and it is worth keeping at modest cost.

The soft sofa sits close to the core upholstery business and costs little to keep in the range, but its weak presentation since launch makes it the most likely candidate for pruning if results stay unremarkable.
The high standing table complements the office and conference range with shared production and low carrying cost, and the shift toward agile, collaborative work keeps its prospects alive.
